frontend.input_padding: right-zero to longest waveform in batch; batch size is one
frontend.spectrum: abs(complex STFT)^2; drop final time frame
frontend.clamp: max(log_mel, max(log_mel over all bins/frames of waveform) - 8)
frontend.valid_mel_frames: floor(sample_count / 160); audio attention_mask[::160], dropping its last entry when sample_count % 160 != 0

generation.slope_calibration: measure max(6, ceil(1.5 * highest speech tokens/s)) on stopped no-list >=2s LibriSpeech, FLEURS and Earnings-22, including concatenated LibriSpeech; subtract generated language prefix through <asr_text>, retain stop; measured slope must be <=25, but generation and serving slope stay 25
generation.no_list_definition: the original request has empty terms and its recorded context_tokens equals zero; tier labels do not determine eligibility
generation.complete_cap_calibration: stopped no-list traces only: max_new_tokens at serving slope25 >= ceil(1.5 * generated length), including language prefix and stop
generation.name_list_rate_evidence: separately report highest prefix-subtracted rate and fixture among stopped listed >=2s speech traces; preserve all listed outputs, including recitation, at their original caps
generation.provisional_cap_rule: fixed reference slope 25: record stop_reason=stop when the last generated token is EOS, even exactly at cap; otherwise require exactly cap tokens and record stop_reason=cap; actual logits processor list must be empty
generation.capped_prefix_identity: retain the exact cap value and generated prefix, independent of any later serving cap; engine parity compares that exact prefix
generation.capped_fixture_report: counts and ordered ids globally, by split, by corpus tier none/30/100/300, and by split/tier; none means no tier label, not necessarily no list
generation.margins: top1 minus top2 of fp32 generation logits at each continuation position

checkpoint_weight_facts.engine_rule: Use the matrix the official loader exposes as thinker.lm_head.weight, even if config tying changes which source tensor supplies it.
